parsed.summary: This study plan introduces foundational concepts in authorship analysis, focusing on linguistic features, stylometric methods, and computational tools. It spans nine sessions from February 1 to February 6, 2027, with no more than 50 minutes of study per day. Topics progress from theory to practical application, culminating in a comparative analysis and seminar preparation.
